label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
// Standing privilege changes. Activity log must be exported to the workspace.
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationNameValue has_any (
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write",
    "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/delete"
)
| extend Role = tostring(parse_json(tostring(Properties_d)).roleDefinitionId)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Caller,
    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    Scope = tostring(Properties_d.scope),
    Role,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
